commands: echo "--- node_modules ---" && ls node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "present" || echo "absent"; echo "--- pwsh ---" && (command -v pwsh && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()') 2>&1 | head -5; echo "--- prettier config ---" && ls .prettierrc* .prettierignore 2>&1 | head; echo "--- podex.psd1 ---" && ls podex.psd1 2>&1
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'Get-Module -ListAvailable Pode, PSSQLite | Select-Object Name, Version | Format-Table' 2>&1 | head -20

pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '
. ./api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1
. ./api/_lib/pantry-render.ps1
$asOf = [datetime]"2026-07-10"
$pass=0;$fail=0
function ok($c,$m){ if($c){$script:pass++} else {$script:fail++; Write-Host "  FAIL: $m" -Foreground Red} }

# Build a mixed item set
function mk($id,$name,$exp){ [pscustomobject]@{ id=$id; name=$name; category="Test"; quantity=1; unit="ea"; expiry=$exp; threshold=1; notes=$null } }
$items = @(
  mk 1 "PastMilk"    "2026-07-01"   # expired (9 days ago)
  mk 2 "TodayEgg"    "2026-07-10"   # expiring (today, 0 days)
  mk 3 "SoonBread"   "2026-07-15"   # expiring (5 days)
  mk 4 "EdgeCheese"  "2026-07-17"   # expiring (exactly 7 days)
  mk 5 "FarRice"     "2026-07-18"   # ok (8 days) - excluded
  mk 6 "NoExpiry"    $null          # none - excluded
  mk 7 "BadDate"     "not-a-date"   # none - excluded
  mk 8 "OldBeans"    "2026-06-20"   # expired (20 days ago)
)

$sel = @(Select-PantryExpiringItems -Items $items -AsOf $asOf)
ok ($sel.Count -eq 5) "expected 5 qualifying, got $($sel.Count)"
$names = $sel | ForEach-Object { $_.name }
ok (($names -join ",") -eq "OldBeans,PastMilk,TodayEgg,SoonBread,EdgeCheese") "order soonest-first: got $($names -join \",\")"
ok ($names -notcontains "FarRice") "excludes >7 days"
ok ($names -notcontains "NoExpiry") "excludes no expiry"
ok ($names -notcontains "BadDate") "excludes unparseable"
# expired ahead of expiring
ok ($names[0] -eq "OldBeans" -and $names[1] -eq "PastMilk") "expired items lead"

# empty / no-qualifying
ok ((@(Select-PantryExpiringItems -Items @() -AsOf $asOf)).Count -eq 0) "empty input -> 0"
ok ((@(Select-PantryExpiringItems -Items @($items[4],$items[5]) -AsOf $asOf)).Count -eq 0) "no qualifying -> 0"

# render list: has wrapper id, listens itemChanged, rows present
$html = Format-PantryExpiringListHtml -Items $sel
ok ($html -match "id=.expiring-list.") "list wrapper id"
ok ($html -match "hx-trigger=.itemChanged from:body.") "list listens itemChanged"
ok ($html -match "hx-get=./htmx/expiring-list.") "list self-fetch url"
ok ($html -match "Expired") "renders Expired badge"
ok ($html -match "Expiring soon") "renders Expiring soon badge"
ok ($html -match "item-row-1") "renders item rows with edit/delete ids"
ok ($html -match "hx-delete=./htmx/item-delete") "rows reuse delete control"

# empty-state render
$emptyHtml = Format-PantryExpiringListHtml -Items @()
ok ($emptyHtml -match "id=.expiring-list.") "empty keeps wrapper id"
ok ($emptyHtml -match "Nothing expiring soon") "empty state message"
ok ($emptyHtml -notmatch "<table") "empty state has no table"

# count badge
$c0 = Format-PantryExpiringCountHtml -Count 0
ok ($c0 -match "id=.nav-expiring-count.") "count wrapper id (0)"
ok ($c0 -match "hx-trigger=.load, itemChanged from:body.") "count self-updates"
ok ($c0 -notmatch "bg-red-600") "count 0 renders no pill"
$c3 = Format-PantryExpiringCountHtml -Count 3
ok ($c3 -match ">3<") "count 3 shows number"
ok ($c3 -match "bg-red-600") "count 3 shows red pill"
ok ($c3 -match "3 items expired or expiring soon") "count 3 aria/title plural"
$c1 = Format-PantryExpiringCountHtml -Count 1
ok ($c1 -match "1 item expired or expiring soon") "count 1 singular"

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "PASS=$pass FAIL=$fail" -Foreground ($(if($fail -eq 0){"Green"}else{"Red"}))
'
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./_tmp_expiring_test.ps1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8433/inventory 2>&1; echo " <- /inventory"; netstat -ano 2>/dev/null | grep -i "8433" | head -3

echo "launched pid $!"

for i in $(seq 1 20); do

done
echo "final code: $code"
echo "code: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8433/inventory)"; pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"'

New-PantryItem -Name "Edge Eggs"       -Category "Dairy"  -Quantity 12 -Unit "ct"    -Expiry "2026-07-17"                    | Out-Null  # expiring (7d edge)
New-PantryItem -Name "Far Rice"        -Category "Grains" -Quantity 5 -Unit "kg"     -Expiry "2026-08-30"                    | Out-Null  # ok (excluded)

$all = @(Get-PantryItems)
$exp = @(Select-PantryExpiringItems -Items $all)

'

echo "=== GET /htmx/expiring-count ==="; curl -s http://localhost:8433/htmx/expiring-count; echo
echo; echo "=== GET /htmx/expiring-list (structure) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:8433/htmx/expiring-list | grep -oE "id='expiring-list'|hx-trigger='itemChanged from:body'|Expired Yogurt|Today Milk|Soon Bread|Edge Eggs|Far Rice|No Date Salt|>Expired<|>Expiring soon<" | cat -n
echo; echo "=== GET /expiring page: nav + heading present? ==="
curl -s http://localhost:8433/expiring | grep -oE "Expiring soon|nav-expiring-count|href='/expiring'|PageName|Pantry - Expiring soon" | sort -u

echo "Soon Bread id=$id"
echo "=== PUT /htmx/item-update (move expiry to 2026-12-31) : response headers ==="
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X PUT http://localhost:8433/htmx/item-update \

echo "=== list after edit: Soon Bread gone? ==="; curl -s http://localhost:8433/htmx/expiring-list | grep -oE "Soon Bread|Expired Yogurt|Today Milk|Edge Eggs" | sort -u

echo "=== POST /htmx/item-create (expiring item) headers ==="
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:8433/htmx/item-create \
  --data-urlencode "name=New Soon Cheese" --data-urlencode "category=Dairy" \
  --data-urlencode "quantity=1" --data-urlencode "unit=block" --data-urlencode "expiry=2026-07-12" --data-urlencode "threshold=1" \
  | grep -iE "HX-Trigger|HTTP/"
echo "count after create:"; curl -s http://localhost:8433/htmx/expiring-count | grep -oE ">[0-9]+<"
nid=$(pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '(Invoke-SqliteQuery -DataSource ./podex.db -Query "SELECT id FROM items WHERE name=@n" -SqlParameters @{n="New Soon Cheese"} -As PSObject).id')
echo "=== DELETE /htmx/item-delete?id=$nid headers ==="

echo "count after delete:"; curl -s http://localhost:8433/htmx/expiring-count | grep -oE ">[0-9]+<"

Invoke-SqliteQuery -DataSource ./podex.db -Query "DELETE FROM [items];" | Out-Null
New-PantryItem -Name "Expired Yogurt" -Category "Dairy"  -Quantity 2  -Unit "cups"   -Expiry "2026-07-02" | Out-Null
New-PantryItem -Name "Today Milk"     -Category "Dairy"  -Quantity 1  -Unit "carton" -Expiry "2026-07-10" | Out-Null
New-PantryItem -Name "Soon Bread"     -Category "Bakery" -Quantity 1  -Unit "loaf"   -Expiry "2026-07-14" | Out-Null

New-PantryItem -Name "Far Rice"       -Category "Grains" -Quantity 5  -Unit "kg"     -Expiry "2026-08-30" | Out-Null

'FAR-PRESENT' : 'far-excluded') + ' / ' + (document.querySelector('#expiring-list').textContent.includes('No Date Salt') ? 'SALT-PRESENT' : 'salt-excluded')"

echo "--- post-commit status ---"; git status --short | head
cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry; git status --short .aidd/features/ | cat; echo "---"; git log --oneline -1
